diagnosis: On Windows, locate=True assembled the Explorer /select switch and the file path into one argument. A path with spaces was parsed incorrectly by Explorer. The fix passes /select, and the path as separate subprocess arguments so the path is quoted as its own argument.
label_note: Human-curated from the issue and merged PR #3478. The PR changes one source line and adds no regression test. Changed-file labels are location proxies, not a diagnosis score. Never pass this file to the agents.
evaluation_note: The report gives the public API, operating system, and a path-with-spaces reproducer, but no implementation path. This is a Windows-specific case and should not be treated as broad platform coverage. The model's training cutoff relative to the public issue and fix is unknown, so contamination cannot be ruled out.
